# Copilot instructions

The project guide is [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) — read it first. It lists the
ground-truth files (`config/eyelash_corne.keymap`, `config/eyelash_corne.conf`,
`build.yaml`, `config/west.yml`), how to route through `docs/reference/`, the known
places where those docs disagree with this repo, and the rules for editing the
keymap.

If a `docs/user-preference/` folder exists, read its `README.md` as well; it
holds owner-specific working-style and typing/ergonomics preferences.

Path-scoped instructions:

- `config/**` → `.github/instructions/config.instructions.md`
- `docs/reference/**` → `.github/instructions/reference-docs.instructions.md`
